ads.title: Exit Planning (Before the Sale)
ads.primary_text:
You've spent years building something worth selling.

But by the time an offer is on the table, the decisions that matter most are already behind you.

The years before a sale are where the outcome is really shaped, in how it's structured, when you sell, and what you actually walk away with. A CFP® professional can help you plan all of that long before you sign.

Request a consultation, with no obligation.
ads.headline: Plan the Exit, Not Just the Sale.
ads.image_direction: v2 GREEN PLACEHOLDER — solid #12493C, on-image headline only. Photography + font finetune pending tone/copy approval (built in Figma under v1).

ads.title: Concentrated Stock Position
ads.primary_text:
Right now, most of your wealth is sitting in one company's stock.

It's worth asking what happens to your plan if that stock has a rough year, because the same concentration that built your wealth can just as quickly work against it.

A CFP® professional can look at the whole picture with you and help you build a plan to ease that risk, without losing sight of the tax bill that comes with selling.

Request a consultation, with no obligation.
ads.headline: When One Stock Is the Risk.
ads.image_direction: v2 GREEN PLACEHOLDER — solid #12493C, on-image headline only. Photography + font finetune pending tone/copy approval (built in Figma under v1).

ads.title: Retirement Timing
ads.primary_text:
You've been saving for thirty years, and somewhere along the way the question quietly shifts from how much to when.

Knowing when it's actually enough isn't about hitting a single number in an account.

It's about how your income, your savings, and your taxes work together once the paychecks stop, and a CFP® professional can help you find the answer that fits your life instead of a rule of thumb.

Request a consultation, with no obligation.
ads.headline: The Hard Part? Knowing When.
ads.image_direction: v2 GREEN PLACEHOLDER — solid #12493C, on-image headline only. Photography + font finetune pending tone/copy approval (built in Figma under v1).

ads.title: Second Opinion
ads.primary_text:
Your advisor manages your investments, and does it well.

But it's fair to wonder when anyone last looked at everything else, because your taxes, your estate plan, and your income strategy all move right along with those investments.

A CFP® professional can look at how the pieces fit together and give you an honest second set of eyes on the whole thing.

Request a consultation, with no obligation.
ads.headline: Who Sees the Whole Picture?

ads.title: Equity Compensation
ads.primary_text:
Your equity finally vested. Now what's the plan?

All that work turned into real money, but equity comp carries tax timing and concentration risk that are easy to get wrong, especially when it's a growing pile of your own company's stock.

A CFP® professional can look at it alongside the rest of your finances and help you turn that pile into a plan.

Request a consultation, with no obligation.
ads.headline: Vested Equity Isn't a Plan.
ads.image_direction: v2 GREEN PLACEHOLDER — solid #12493C, on-image headline only. Photography + font finetune pending tone/copy approval (built in Figma under v1).

ads.title: Plan for the Unplanned
ads.primary_text:
A plan that only works if nothing ever goes wrong isn't much of a plan.

So it's worth asking what happens to yours if something does, because most plans look fine right up until life surprises them.

A CFP® professional can pressure-test yours against the things you can't schedule, so the whole picture is built to hold even when one part shifts.

See what a plan built for the unexpected looks like.

ads.title: Legacy / What You Leave
ads.primary_text:
One day, everything you built will pass to the people you love.

The real question is whether they'll inherit a plan or a puzzle, because most families leave behind accounts scattered in a dozen places and no map to make sense of them.

A CFP® professional can help you leave a plan your family can actually follow, so what you built becomes clarity for them instead of a project.

Request a consultation, with no obligation.

ads.title: The Whole Picture
ads.primary_text:
Your investments, your taxes, and your estate plan are each handled well on their own.

But it's worth asking whether anyone is making sure they add up, because handled apart, even good decisions can quietly work against each other.

A CFP® professional can look at all of it as one plan, so your money pulls in the same direction instead of three.

Request a consultation, with no obligation.

ads.title: Mass-Affluent · Retirement Income Longevity

You spent your whole career saving for this.

The question that lingers is whether it will actually last as long as you do, because a long retirement turns steady saving into a harder one: making the money last through decades you can't fully predict.

A CFP® professional can look at the whole picture and help you build an income plan for the long haul, rather than one built around a single number on the day you retire.

Request a consultation, with no obligation.

What's harder to see is what they cost you, because the fees you never notice can quietly work against you, year after year.

A CFP® professional can look at the whole picture with you and help you see what you're actually paying, and whether it's working for you.

Request a consultation, with no obligation.

A CFP® professional can look at the whole picture and show you where you really stand, so your confidence comes from knowing instead of guessing.
